title: Sharp Convex Concentration for Symmetric Random Tensors with Subgaussian Coordinates
summary: Let $X=(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$ have independent coordinates with mean zero, variance one, and $\|X_i\|_{ψ_2}\le K$, and let $H_d=(\mathbb R^n)^{\otimes_2 d}$. Let $L>0$ and let $f:H_d\to\mathbb R$ be convex and $L$-Lipschitz. We prove that, for $0\le t\le c_KLn^{d/2}$, \[ \textsf{P}\left\{ \left\lvert f(X^{\otimes d})-\textsf{E}f(X^{\otimes d})\right\rvert >t \right\} \le C\exp\left[-c_K\mathcal I_{n,d}\left( \frac{t}{L n^{(d-1)/2}} \right)\right], \] where \[ \mathcal I_{n,d}(s)= \min\left\{ \frac{s^2}{d^2}, \frac{s^2}{d\log(e+nd/s^2)} \right\},\qquad s>0, \qquad \mathcal I_{n,d}(0)=0. \] The…
